result.summary: Re-ran the full suite against a verified-clean DB (dropped all 17 pre-existing letflow_test* databases first, confirmed no concurrent mix/beam processes, so every partition's ecto.create+ecto.migrate built fresh -- ruled out the versions_missing/stale-tenant_template mechanism two prior steps hit). Backend: scripts/test_parallel.sh, N=16 -- combined 4466 tests, 6 properties, 7 failures (4465/4472 passed); all 7 failures are in partition 5's Letflow.IdentityMigrationTest, a NEW cluster (Postgrex undefined_column: u0.role_claims_synced_at against the legacy public.users table). Targeted serial re-run of the 3 previously-reported regressions (auth_pipeline_test.exs, api_pipeline_integration_test.exs, req077_promotion_pipeline_test.exs) plus test/letflow/plugs/iss0736_oidc_live_revocation_test.exs: Result: 49 passed, 0 failures -- confirms all 3 prior regressions are fixed and the REQ-378 backend test file is clean. Frontend: npm test (the correct, exclude-scoped script) -- 106 test files, 728 tests, 0 failures, including web/src/api/__tests__/identity.removeMembers.test.ts (2/2 passed). Root-caused the new backend regression: lib/letflow/identity_migration.ex's copy_users/2 does a bare `from(u in User, ...)` with no `select:` restriction, so it now selects :role_claims_synced_at (added to Letflow.Identity.User's schema by this same rework commit 4d63a6a1) against the legacy, frozen public.users table, which never had that column. copy_groups/2 in the same module already carries an explicit comment defending against this exact hazard class (from REQ-074's earlier column addition) via a restricted select; copy_users/2 was never given the equivalent guard, so REQ-378's new column reopened the hole. Confirmed branch-caused via `git log --oneline main..HEAD -- lib/letflow/identity/user.ex` (only commit touching that file on this branch is 4d63a6a1). Full detail in the new report file.

issues.description: lib/letflow/identity_migration.ex copy_users/2 has no select: restriction, so REQ-378's new Letflow.Identity.User field :role_claims_synced_at is now queried against the legacy public.users table (which never had it), causing 7 deterministic failures in test/letflow/identity_migration_test.exs (Postgrex undefined_column error). Fix: restrict copy_users/2's select to the legacy table's real columns, mirroring copy_groups/2's existing pattern for the same hazard class.
